settings.prompt: Edit only the single FLUVIX amber spray bottle in this cropped real video. Preserve its existing horizontal translation, outline, cap-up long-axis orientation, lighting, camera and background. Change the body surface motion from a front-facing slide to a visible physical axial roll about its own longitudinal axis: the attached curved front lettering must travel around the cylindrical edge, disappear fully to show the unprinted reverse side, and return to the front before the last frame. No in-plane rotation, no wobbling, no label crossfade, no new bottle, no carton. Keep the exact source first and last appearances. Do not move any bottle contour or shadow. No audio.
settings.negative_prompt: static front label sliding, label dissolve, planar image spin, new carton, extra bottle, changing geometry, camera motion

compositePolicy: Body-interior tracking mask only, all pixels outside mask immutable at lossless RGB stage; no rectangle paste; independent alignment/endpoint/matte review required. No site publication.
